institutions.name: Merrill Edge / BofA Premier
institutions.clawback: ~90-day funding hold on bonus; tier benefits ongoing, no clawback
institutions.note3: $1M = BofA Rewards Premier tier (formerly Diamond Honors)
institutions.standout: 75% credit-card rewards boost; 0.25% mortgage + 0.625% HELOC discount
institutions.verdict: Total-value winner for a leveraged real-estate operator

institutions.name: Robinhood Gold
institutions.clawback: Early-removal fee if withdrawn < 5 yrs; must hold Gold 1 yr
institutions.note3: 3% if margin balance >= $10k (rewards-season, VERIFY if still open)
institutions.standout: Highest raw match at this asset level; 2% = $40k at $2M
institutions.verdict: Cash king, but a 5-year lock and app-tier service

institutions.name: Fidelity
institutions.note3: Will occasionally match a competitor offer on request (VERIFY)
institutions.standout: Best auto-sweep (SPAXX ~4%), no lock, strong private-client service
institutions.verdict: Zero cash, but highest flexibility and yield floor

institutions.name: J.P. Morgan / Chase Private Client
institutions.note3: Private Client relationship offers are negotiated, not posted
institutions.standout: Relationship banking, negotiable mortgage pricing, CPC perks
institutions.verdict: Strong bundler if you negotiate the private-client package

institutions.name: SoFi Invest
institutions.note3: Exact $1M/$2M tier not posted; modeled at $10k cap
institutions.standout: Cash plus member banking ecosystem and relationship APY
institutions.verdict: Solid cash if the top tier confirms; verify before acting

institutions.name: E*TRADE (Morgan Stanley)
institutions.note3: Larger bonuses require Morgan Stanley wealth negotiation (VERIFY)
institutions.standout: Access to Morgan Stanley wealth platform and lending
institutions.verdict: Weak public cash; value is the MS relationship door

institutions.name: Public.com
institutions.note3: No Gold subscription required; flat 1% at any size
institutions.standout: Cleanest large-dollar match with no subscription gate
institutions.verdict: Second-best raw cash, same 5-year lock as Robinhood

institutions.name: Interactive Brokers
institutions.note3: Lowest margin in market; benchmark + ~0.75% tiered
institutions.standout: Cheapest cost of capital (~4.8% at $500k+ debit) and high idle-cash yield
institutions.verdict: The margin trader's home; no cash, all carry advantage

institutions.name: Charles Schwab
institutions.pct: Investor Reward up to $6,000 (public top tier)
institutions.clawback: 12-month hold; negotiable higher via Private Client
institutions.note3: Private Client desk will negotiate above the public tier (VERIFY)
institutions.verdict: Balanced; negotiate before accepting the posted $6k
institutions.sweep: Poor default sweep (~0.45%); must buy MMF manually

institutions.name: tastytrade
institutions.note3: Referral code required at signup; caps at $5k regardless of size
institutions.standout: Shortest lock among cash offers relative to dollars, options tooling
institutions.verdict: Fine for a trader, but the flat cap is weak at $2M

watchlist.name: Citigold Private Client
watchlist.note: Relationship cash historically up to ~$2k-$5k plus banking perks; not posted at $1M tier

watchlist.name: Wells Fargo Premier
watchlist.note: Premier relationship pricing and Bilt-style card synergy; brokerage bonus not posted

watchlist.name: HSBC Premier
watchlist.note: Global Premier relationship; US brokerage transfer bonus not currently posted

watchlist.name: M1 Finance
watchlist.note: Advertises up to $10,000 transfer bonus; exact $1M/$2M tier and hold not confirmed

watchlist.name: Webull
watchlist.note: Tiered ACAT bonus advertised; top-tier value and hold not confirmed for $1M+
